title: Package barrels only re-export and match the package exports map
statement: Every package index and the CLI runtime assembly barrel MUST contain only re-exports, each relative re-export MUST resolve to a module that exists, and the development entry that a workspace package declares for its root export MUST be its source index, so a module becomes part of a package public surface only by an explicit re-export that a reviewer can read in one place.
rationale: A barrel that declares behavior, or an exports map that points past it, would widen a package public surface without a visible re-export; keeping barrels re-export-only keeps reachability and the inventory claims honest (issue #295).

strategy.rationale: A deterministic contract test reads each barrel and the package manifests; trace links the test.
